pre_analysis_method_note: Before any positive-cost full-data analysis, the initial guard found 104 forwarded baseline misses with saved latency equal to 10 times deadline. This prevents unconditional recovery of every latency value, but does not prevent exact deadline-outcome scoring: these tasks cannot regain success with added nonnegative cost. Initial manifest retained separately.
primary_comparison: fresh per-task placement with constant forwarding overhead minus zero-forwarding ingress
qualification: Exact zero reconstruction; exact full-run-prefix binding; direct 10-step probes at all four positive grid costs. Identifiable task latency/outcomes match shape/dtype/bytes and state fields are unchanged. Full-data penalty-equal already-misses have ambiguous point latency, marked unknown, and provably unchanged missed outcomes at nonnegative cost. Report deadline counts, not latency moments.
scope: One fleet draw, fixed extra per-forwarded-admitted-task latency, same frozen actor/trace/queues/admission/service/energy; no topology, congestion or delayed execution arrivals modeled.
